name: Warm-Up · General Knowledge
description: Easy mixed trivia to get the room going before the big sets

questions.q: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.fact: Canberra was purpose-built as the compromise capital between Sydney and Melbourne.

questions.q: How many hearts does an octopus have?
questions.fact: Two pump blood to the gills, one to the rest of the body.

questions.q: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
In which year did South Africa win their first Rugby World Cup?
questions.fact: Francois Pienaar lifted the trophy, with Nelson Mandela in the stands.

questions.q: What is the most consumed beverage in the world after water?
Which city is South Africa's administrative capital?
questions.fact: SA has three capitals: executive Pretoria, legislative Cape Town, judicial Bloemfontein.

questions.q: What is the only mammal capable of true flight?
How many minutes are there in a full day?
Which country has the most time zones?
questions.fact: France has 12 thanks to its overseas territories.
